title: US accuses American of allegedly wiping his phone using a ‘duress’ password during border search
summary: A U.S. citizen has asked a court to throw out the government's claim that he gave over a passcode to border authorities that wiped his phone's data, opening up fresh questions about a person's constitutional rights at the U.S. border.
llm_summary: A US citizen is suing after allegedly entering a "duress" password to wipe his phone's data during a border search. He's asking a court to dismiss the government's claim, raising questions about individual rights at the border. The case centers around the balance between protecting personal data and complying with border authorities.
